show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Graham Duncan - Talent Whisperer - [Invest Like the Best, EP.409]
summary: Its compound annual growth rate (CAGR) over the past decade is 12.5%, and it has outperformed the top 5% of its peer group over five-, ten-, and 15-year periods. He cautions that it took him three years to warm up to the Enneagram, and that he sees it “more a tool for personal and spiritual growth than a personality framework per se”. The beauty of being a wild gardener is that growth happens without constant intervention.
